content.text: This guide will give you a logical step by step procedure for construction of the Lasersaur  Door Frame

introduction_raw: This guide will give you a logical step by step procedure for construction of the Lasersaur  Door Frame
introduction_rendered: This guide will give you a logical step by step procedure for construction of the Lasersaur Door Frame

lines.text_raw: Install 3 hinges - two towards the ends, and one in the middle, by eye.
lines.text_rendered: Install 3 hinges - two towards the ends, and one in the middle, by eye.

lines.text_raw: Mount the 4040 extrusion top door frame, and it should be 2.8 cm off edge on each side.
lines.text_rendered: Mount the 4040 extrusion top door frame, and it should be 2.8 cm off edge on each side.

lines.text_raw: When mounting the 4040 extrusion - push it all the way up so that hinges can close fully. The hinges must pushed as far to the corner of the extrusion as possible.
lines.text_rendered: When mounting the 4040 extrusion - push it all the way up so that hinges can close fully. The hinges must pushed as far to the corner of the extrusion as possible.

lines.text_raw: The two 6 cm wide tinted glazing pieces serve as a seal for the door. Mark hole locations and drill bolt holes through these, and mount to the hinged 4040 extrusion.
lines.text_rendered: The two 6 cm wide tinted glazing pieces serve as a seal for the door. Mark hole locations and drill bolt holes through these, and mount to the hinged 4040 extrusion.

lines.text_raw: Match drill through the second piece of glazing.
lines.text_rendered: Match drill through the second piece of glazing.

lines.text_raw: Take the protective cover off the glazing.
lines.text_rendered: Take the protective cover off the glazing.

lines.text_raw: Bolt the seals to the 4040 extrusion.
lines.text_rendered: Bolt the seals to the 4040 extrusion.

lines.text_raw: Begin assembling the door frame with corner brackets.
lines.text_rendered: Begin assembling the door frame with corner brackets.

lines.text_raw: Build the verticals of the door frame.
lines.text_rendered: Build the verticals of the door frame.

lines.text_raw: Place door on top of the gantry frame.
lines.text_rendered: Place door on top of the gantry frame.

lines.text_raw: Mount 3 door mounts to the 4040 hinged extrusion. Use double brackets on the ends and a single bracket in the middle.
lines.text_rendered: Mount 3 door mounts to the 4040 hinged extrusion. Use double brackets on the ends and a single bracket in the middle.

lines.text_raw: Use 2 larger washers and 5 smaller washers on a 20 mm screw, and then 3 more larger washers.
lines.text_rendered: Use 2 larger washers and 5 smaller washers on a 20 mm screw, and then 3 more larger washers.

lines.text_raw: Mount the rod end to the inner part of the outer 4040 extrusion.
lines.text_rendered: Mount the rod end to the inner part of the outer 4040 extrusion.

lines.text_raw: Mount the base end of air spring similarly.
lines.text_rendered: Mount the base end of air spring similarly.

lines.text_raw: Select the position of base end such that the door is open to a comfortable height at the maximum spring extension.
lines.text_rendered: Select the position of base end such that the door is open to a comfortable height at the maximum spring extension.

lines.text_raw: Glue sponge shock absorbers on the underside of the door.
lines.text_rendered: Glue sponge shock absorbers on the underside of the door.

summary: Step by step guide of how the Lasersaur Door Frame is assembled.
title: How to build the OSE Lasersaur Door Frame
